semantic_definition: Primary key identifying one OD-005 amendment operation

semantic_definition: The open-decision this operation belongs to

semantic_definition: Short human-readable name for the operation

semantic_definition: The category of write this operation performs (or would perform)

validation_rule: must be drawn from this controlled vocabulary; a new value requires this registry's own schema to be amended first

semantic_definition: The file this operation creates or modifies

semantic_definition: Whether this operation has actually been carried out in the working tree/committed history (distinct from historical_status, which describes the frozen specification record itself)
source_basis: derived by cross-checking this session's commit history against each operation's own postcondition
validation_rule: must reflect the CURRENT state, re-verified at registry-write time, not the state at original specification time

allowed_values: FROZEN, PENDING_FREEZE (OP-10 and any future operation's registry row, applied in the working tree before push/server sync; see WAVE_2_OD_005_OP10_ENUM_CONTRACT_DECISION_DRAFT.md)

semantic_definition: Free-text clarification (e.g. schema-version differences between OP-01..08 and OP-09)
